Team —

Quick heads-up: finance asked us to do a clean revenue roll-up and commit reconciliation for the month close + QBR packet assembly. Goal is a concise one-page executive brief per region and a combined roll-up for leadership by EOD Wednesday (02/03).

Please do the following before Tuesday 5pm PT:
- Update your active commit deals in HubSpot with current stage and latest projected close date. Put a one-line note if the commit is at risk.
- Populate the attached revenue_rollup_template_v1.xlsx for each deal you own (columns: Account, ARR, Stage, Close Month, Owner Note).
- Flag any large (> $250k ARR) renewals or procurement stalls so we can escalate.

I'll assemble the leadership brief and drop the draft in Drive. Sean, can you run an internal check on any duplicate ACV counts before I publish?

Attachments: [Attachment: revenue_rollup_template_v1.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)]

Thanks —
Markus Klein
